name: OPERCULINA TURPENTHUM
mind_symptoms: Delirium associated with restlessness, loquacity. Tendency to escape from bed; ravings, pains cause fainting.
gi_symptoms: Watery diarrhœa, profuse with sinking sensation, Cholera morbus. Hæmorrhoids.
skin_symptoms: Lymphatic glands enlarged and indurated. Boils and slowly suppurating abscesses.

source.title: OPERCULINA TURPENTHUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
